Theme

Latin word

repudiō

repudiō, repudiāre, repudiāvī, repudiātum

verb, first conjugation, transitive

reject, turn down (an offer, a plan, advice)

In this lexicon

  • reject

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Trin. 455: quī condiciōnem hanc repudiēs?; Caes. B.G. 1.40 (Lewis & Short): grātiam populī Rōmānī repudiāre

Examples

  • Satin' tū es sānus mentis aut animī tuī, quī condiciōnem hanc repudiēs?

    Are you in your right mind, turning down an offer like this?Plaut. Trin. 454–455

    In the entry for reject

  • Repudiō quod cōnsilium prīmum intenderam.

    I’m dropping the plan I first had in mind.Ter. And. 733

    In the entry for reject

  • An id est sapere, ut quī beneficium ā benevolente repudiēs?

    Is that being wise, to turn down a kindness from someone who means you well?Plaut. Trin. 637

    In the entry for reject
